name: Oishii 1g Live Resin Disposable
description: Lineage: Flavor Pack x Moonbow #112 Breeder: Archive Seed Bank Terpenes: Limonene, Linalool, ß-Pinene Effects: Sleepy, Creative, Euphoric Aroma: Tropical, Jasmine, Pine Straight from the land of the rising sun, Oishii (meaning 'delicious' in Japanese) lives up to its name with exceptional flavor. Pro Gro's master growers have captured a perfect harmony of sweet and savory notes that'll transport your senses to a zen garden of tranquility. Like a perfectly crafted sushi roll, this strain delivers a balanced experience that's both refined and powerful.
